- From our side: I'll bring Rafael (solutions lead) and Marissa (customer success) to cover integration and rollout.

Proposed 60-minute slots (PST):
- Wed 2026-09-15 10:00-11:00
- Wed 2026-09-15 14:00-15:00
- Thu 2026-09-16 09:00-10:00

Can you confirm which slot works best and who will attend from ClearSight? Once confirmed I'll send a calendar invite with the Zoom link and an agenda.

I've attached a short agenda and a one-pager so your team can skim before the session.
